name: Magami Kyousuke
source:
A member of the Narumi Detective Agency. Kyousuke's a kind young man with a simple personality, and perhaps because of that, he easily gets into trouble. When Kyousuke was young, he had lost his parents in a car accident and as a result was raised by his grandfather. 

The main thing Kyousuke remembers from his childhood is an antique pendant his mother wore, which is currently missing. Because of this he wanted to at least find a pendant of the same type and use it as a memento, so he turned the Narumi Detective Agency to request an investigation about the origins pendant. However, when Kyuosuke learned that the office was managed by [url=/c123785]Kyouka[/url] alone and was no longer able to properly conduct detective work, Kyousuke sympathized with her and decides to work for her. He is, of course, investigating the origins of his mother's pendant in between his normal work.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
